voiceName: Dorien (phone, garden, no denoise), the clone used for Rooted. Never de-ess it.

lines.n_intro: So I built Don Tuco. He's our farm's host, and he lives right inside WhatsApp, on AWS.
lines.n_wedge: And it's not just my farm. According to AWS, Latin America is over forty percent of all WhatsApp Business adoption.
lines.n_demo: This is a real conversation, on my phone, with the live agent.
lines.n_demo_book: He checks the real calendar, quotes the price, and writes the booking to the ledger. The confirmation email goes out through Amazon SES.
lines.n_demo_more: Directions arrive as a WhatsApp location pin. He's honest that he's an AI. And anything he shouldn't decide, he hands straight to me.
lines.n_arch: Under the hood, AWS End User Messaging Social delivers every message through Amazon SNS to Lambda, where a Claude agent on Amazon Bedrock works with six booking tools. DynamoDB keeps the ledger, every booking lands in my Google Calendar, and SES sends the confirmations. No third-party WhatsApp provider, and billing stays on AWS.
lines.n_numbers: Measured on the live agent: a median reply in about eight seconds, from the guest's message to the answer, and about two cents per reply, all in.
lines.n_pack: Everything about my farm lives in one config file: tours, prices, time slots, languages and directions. A new operator is a new file, not a new build.
lines.n_close: Don Tuco. Every guest greeted in seconds, every booking in the ledger.
